result:
All 5 findings are closed in PR #419: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/419

Summary of what was done, per finding:

1. **ABAC (Critical)** — generalized the existing single-attribute `conditionField`/`conditionOperator` pattern in `approval-workflow-service.ts` into a reusable multi-condition evaluator (`src/lib/abac.ts`), plus a new org-configurable deny-only policy overlay (`abac_policies` table + `abac-policy-service.ts`), wired into `decideApprovalStep`.
2. **Audit Trail (full payloads)** — found this was largely already resolved (Wave 144/146 already store full PII-redacted prompt/response text); the real gap was no TTL, closed with a `payload_purged_at` column + daily purge cron.
3. **Unified audit search** — new `compliance.audit_search` view unioning `audit_logs`/`orchestra_executions`/`activity_log`, with `security_invoker` + an explicit org-scoping filter on every branch so it fails closed rather than ever leaking cross-org data.
4. **Maintainability dashboard** — a real 0-100 score built from existing signals (guardrail violations, improvement backlog, dependency health), avoiding the fake "Maintainability Auditor" role the audit org docs had already correctly declined to build.
5. **GP-06/09/26** — GP-06 (Knowledge self-check) was genuinely missing and now has real code; GP-09 and GP-26 turned out to be substantially already-enforced (stale `CONSTITUTION.yaml` status), so I corrected the docs instead of duplicating working code, and added the one real remaining piece for GP-09 (numeric confidence computed at dispatch time, not just an optional reviewer value at closure).

Verification: `tsc` clean, 1443/1443 tests passing, lint clean, all governance CI scripts (guardrail-presence, asset-registry-coverage, doc-cross-references, etc.) passing. PR is not self-merged, per the task's own instruction — left for the supervising session's audit, with `PROGRESS.md` documenting what to do next (apply the 4 new migrations, note a pre-existing unrelated migration-number collision at 0224 that isn't mine to fix).
